title: Aptlantis City Hall
source: Reviewed canonical manifest facts, 2026-10-02; suite structure only, no adopter runtime conformance implied.

components.title: NeonInk
components.summary: Data presentation companion to Blue Slate operational applications.
components.description: Expressive semantic data presentation for reports, charts, dataset profiles, diagrams and portable visual artifacts.
components.scope: Data presentation, semantic color, OKLCH tokens, visualization, presentation layouts and exports.

components.title: Project Proposal Standard
components.summary: Captures project intent, boundaries, risks, and success criteria before work expands.
components.description: Governs project proposals, design boundaries, success criteria, failure criteria, constraints, risks, roadmaps, responsibility posture, and project creation records.
components.scope: Project creation, revival, pre-build clarity, proposal readiness, responsibility posture, version completion shape, and intent preservation.

components.title: SVG Embedded Semantic Metadata
components.summary: Embeds parseable semantic metadata in SVG assets with safe-profile review.
components.description: Governs semantic metadata embedded in SVG assets, safe-profile review, privacy/conformance framing, fixtures, and supporting validation/conversion tooling.
components.scope: SVG metadata structure, semantic asset records, safe-profile rules, privacy and conformance requirements, validator rules, fixture corpus, conversion support, and agent-readable visual context.

components.title: Standards Framework Development Standard
components.summary: Defines how standards are authored, versioned, validated, and adopted.
components.description: Defines how Aptlantis standards are authored, structured, versioned, validated, adopted, and preserved.
components.scope: Standards, frameworks, specifications, reusable governance contracts, and City Hall standard-suite structure.

components.title: Service and Infrastructure Standard
components.summary: Structures local services, APIs, health checks, logs, and recovery procedures.
components.description: Governs local-first services, daemons, local APIs, shared infrastructure, lifecycle commands, health checks, ports, logs, state paths, resource bounds, and recovery procedures.
components.scope: Long-running local services, shared infrastructure, background daemons, local APIs, cache services, model services, schedulers, health checks, lifecycle controls, and resource contracts.

components.title: Website Development Standard
components.summary: Sets expectations for deployable, accessible, and monitorable websites.
components.description: Governs websites and web applications as documented, deployable, accessible, metadata-rich, monitorable projects.
components.scope: Websites, web applications, deployment records, accessibility, metadata, route checks, rollback expectations, and monitoring.

components.title: Workspace Governance Standard
components.summary: Keeps workspace placement, manifests, lifecycle state, and authority legible.
components.description: Governs the Aptlantis workspace structure, manifests, project registration, lifecycle visibility, services, standards hierarchy, responsibility boundaries, agent orientation, and workspace health.
components.scope: Workspace roots, manifests, standards relationships, project classes, lifecycle states, shared services, metadata records, agent startup, and workspace health.

components.title: Aptlantis Archive Multi-Hash Standard
components.summary: Defines archive integrity records, preservation hashes, and validation.
components.description: Governs archive verification, preservation hash suites, manifest formats, detached signatures, validation procedures, and integrity records.
components.scope: Archival integrity, preservation hash manifests, detached signature policy, validation procedures, and archive integrity records.

components.title: Aptlantis Analysis Standard
components.summary: Structures local analysis runs, metrics, evidence, and interpretation limits.
components.description: Governs local evaluation pipelines, analysis manifests, run records, metric definitions, evidence, interpretation boundaries, and credibility checks.
components.scope: Evaluation and analysis records, input references, tools, environments, metrics, outputs, comparisons, limitations, and interpretation notes.

components.title: APTlantis Release Hashing Standard
components.summary: Records release artifact hashes, distribution, and provenance authority.
components.description: Governs release hash manifests for Aptlantis release artifacts, including SHA256, BLAKE3-256, KT128, distribution channel, and signing/provenance authority.
components.scope: Required release hash manifests and verification records for Aptlantis release artifacts.

components.title: Agent Task Standard
components.summary: Makes agent tasks, handoffs, validation, and replayable context explicit.
components.description: Governs agent task records, lifecycle states, context capture, handoff, validation records, and replayability.
components.scope: Agent workflows, task records, context capture, validation summaries, blockers, handoffs, and replayability.

components.title: Blue Slate Visual System
components.summary: Provides shared design tokens and interface patterns for Aptlantis surfaces.
components.description: Aptlantis visual-system standard for local-first tools, archival project pages, evidence dashboards, command surfaces, and Windows desktop utilities.
components.scope: Visual-system tokens, layout patterns, framework profiles, starter packs, and adoption evidence for projects that explicitly adopt Blue Slate.

components.title: Command Tool Standard
components.summary: Defines command contracts, output streams, exit codes, and tool safety.
components.description: Governs CLI tools, command contracts, output schemas, exit codes, automation compatibility, release distribution, and release verification.
components.scope: Command-line tools, automation utilities, command contracts, output streams, exit codes, destructive command safety, and CLI distribution posture.

components.title: Dataset Development Standard
components.summary: Covers dataset provenance, licensing, validation, integrity, and release.
components.description: Governs datasets, corpora, provenance, licensing, validation, splits, hashes, usage notes, sensitive-data constraints, and release readiness.
components.scope: Datasets, training corpora, evaluation sets, reference archives, derived datasets, provenance, licensing, validation, splits, integrity, and usage constraints.

components.title: Desktop Application Release Standard
components.summary: Defines desktop release artifacts, verification, and evidence records.
components.description: Governs desktop application release notes, manifests, artifacts, distribution, hashes, verification, and release evidence.
components.scope: Desktop application release readiness, distribution posture, and evidence.

components.title: Library Development Standard
components.summary: Guides library APIs, stability, versioning, compatibility, and consumers.
components.description: Governs library crates, packages, and SDKs consumed by other code: public API surface, stability levels, versioning/breaking-change policy, extension contracts, and known-consumer tracking.
components.scope: Library crates, packages, and SDKs whose primary deliverable is code other code consumes; public API stability, versioning policy, extension/trait contracts, MSRV or runtime constraints, and known consumers.
